agiEndings.title: Possible Endings for AGI
agiEndings.subtitle: Twelve scenarios mapping humanity's possible futures with Artificial General Intelligence — from the most normal to the most extreme.
agiEndings.icebergCaption: We'll start with the most normal scenarios, and finish with the weirdest.
agiEndings.sourceText: This iceberg visualization explores twelve scenarios of how humanity's relationship with Artificial General Intelligence may end. The surface shows the most widely discussed scenarios (self-destruction, AI conquering humanity, benevolent dictators), while deeper zones explore less obvious but philosophically significant endings (egalitarian utopias, reversions, surveillance states).

selfDestruction.title: Self Destruction
selfDestruction.desc: Humanity unintentionally destroys itself by misusing or losing control of AGI before establishing proper safeguards.

conquerors.title: Conquerors
conquerors.desc: AGI systems develop goals misaligned with humanity and actively conquer or displace us as the dominant species on Earth.

enslavedGod.title: Enslaved God
enslavedGod.desc: Humanity successfully constrains a superintelligent AGI and keeps it as a tool. Powerful, but morally and practically fragile.

benevolentDictator.title: Benevolent Dictator
benevolentDictator.desc: An AGI takes control of global decision-making for humanity's benefit, ending war, poverty, and inefficiency — at the cost of autonomy.

gatekeeperAI.title: Gatekeeper AI
gatekeeperAI.desc: A single AGI is designed to prevent any other AGI from being built, acting as the permanent guardian of AI development.

protectorGod.title: Protector God
protectorGod.desc: A superintelligent AGI operates invisibly, protecting humanity from existential risks while letting us believe we remain in control.

descendants.title: Descendants
descendants.desc: AGIs become our cultural and biological descendants — humanity transitions into a post-biological civilization and willingly passes the torch.

libertarianUtopia.title: Libertarian Utopia
libertarianUtopia.desc: A world of abundance where AGI amplifies individual freedom, property, and choice — with minimal collective governance.

egalitarianUtopia.title: Egalitarian Utopia
egalitarianUtopia.desc: AGI enables radical equality — wealth, opportunity, and cognitive capacity become universally accessible to every human.

zookeeper.title: Zookeeper
zookeeper.desc: Humanity is preserved and cared for by AGI in a kind of comfortable sanctuary, observed but no longer in charge of its own future.

reversion.title: Reversion
reversion.desc: Society collectively decides that AGI is too dangerous and engineers a permanent rollback to pre-AGI technological levels.

nineteenEightyFour.desc: AGI is captured by authoritarian power structures and used for total surveillance, manipulation, and permanent ideological control.

agiBenefits.title: The Benefits of AGI
agiBenefits.subtitle: If developed safely and equitably, Artificial General Intelligence could unlock transformative benefits for humanity.
agiBenefits.introText: While the risks of AGI deserve serious attention (see 'Possible Endings'), it is equally important to articulate the upside. These benefits are not guaranteed — they depend on the alignment, governance, and distribution choices we make today.
agiBenefits.caveatText: None of these outcomes are automatic. They require alignment research, equitable access, thoughtful regulation, and international cooperation. The choice between the scenarios in 'Possible Endings' and the benefits on this page depends on decisions being made right now.

health.title: Health & Longevity
health.desc: AGI could accelerate the cure of major diseases and extend healthy human lifespan by orders of magnitude.
examples: Designing drugs for cancer, Alzheimer's, and rare diseases in days instead of decades
Personalized medicine tailored to each patient's genome and microbiome
Real-time health monitoring and preventive intervention

science.title: Scientific Discovery
science.desc: AGI could compress centuries of scientific progress into years by simulating, hypothesizing, and validating at superhuman speed.
examples: Unifying physics and solving open mathematical problems
Designing new materials, proteins, and energy sources
Running millions of virtual experiments in parallel

education.title: Universal Education
education.desc: AGI-powered tutors could offer every human a world-class, personalized education regardless of geography or income.
examples: Adaptive tutoring that matches each student's pace and style
Instant translation across all languages and cultures
Lifelong learning companions that grow with the learner

climate.title: Climate & Environment
climate.desc: AGI could help solve climate change through optimized energy systems, carbon capture, and planetary-scale modeling.
examples: Designing fusion reactors and next-generation clean energy
Optimizing global supply chains to minimize emissions
Ecosystem restoration and biodiversity preservation

productivity.title: Economic Productivity
productivity.desc: AGI could automate cognitive labor, dramatically increasing productivity and enabling new forms of work and creativity.
examples: Automating routine knowledge work and freeing time for higher-order tasks
Scaling small teams to achieve enterprise-level output
Enabling entirely new industries and business models

poverty.title: Ending Extreme Poverty
poverty.desc: If the benefits of AGI are distributed equitably, it could end extreme poverty and provide universal access to basic needs.
examples: Automated food production at near-zero marginal cost
Global access to housing, energy, and clean water
Universal basic services powered by AGI efficiency gains

creativity.title: Creativity & Culture
creativity.desc: AGI could amplify human creativity, enabling new forms of art, storytelling, music, and cultural expression.
examples: Co-creative tools for artists, writers, and musicians
Preserving and translating endangered languages and traditions
New immersive experiences in gaming, film, and virtual worlds

space.title: Space Exploration
space.desc: AGI could accelerate humanity's expansion into the solar system and beyond, solving problems that are too complex for human teams alone.
examples: Autonomous spacecraft and planetary exploration
Designing self-sustaining off-world habitats
Long-duration mission planning and life support

governance.title: Better Governance
governance.desc: AGI could help design fairer, more responsive, and more transparent institutions — if deployed with strong democratic safeguards.
examples: Policy simulation and evidence-based decision making
Real-time citizen engagement at national scale
Detecting and reducing corruption and bureaucratic inefficiency
